metaDescription: Shopify store for Starlet Shoes: men's, women's and kids' footwear plus fragrances, picture-led category links, sale badges, a wishlist and order tracking.
summary: Shopify store for a Pakistani footwear brand selling men's, women's and kids' shoes and fragrances.
overview: Starlet sells footwear for men, women and kids in Pakistan, from formal shoes, loafers and peshawari chappals to heels, flats and school shoes, along with a fragrance line. We built Starlet's Shopify store on the Glozin theme to bring shoes and fragrances together in one storefront.
challenge: The catalog is wide in two directions: many men's styles, a separate women's range, a kids' section with school shoes, and fragrances that sit outside footwear entirely. Seasonal sales such as the 10.10 event also needed a prominent place without crowding out the regular range.
approach: The header holds New arrival, Men, Women, Kids, Fragrances, the current sale and a Track order link, under a free delivery announcement bar. Collection pages open with round picture links for each style (formal, casual, loafer, sports, peshawari, sandal, slipper, leather specialist), followed by a filter button, grid and list views, sorting and product cards with the discount percentage and the amount saved. On phones, a fixed bottom bar gives quick access to home, shop, wishlist and cart.
outcome: A footwear and fragrance store where shoppers move from department to style through pictures, see sale savings on every card and can track an order without contacting support.

process.title: Departments and styles
process.body: Men, Women and Kids each open a menu of styles, from formal shoes, boots and peshawari for men to court shoes, sling backs, mules and sneakers for women, and school and sport shoes for kids.

process.title: Picture-led collections
process.body: Round photo links at the top of each collection let shoppers jump between styles by sight. Below them, product cards show the discount badge, the rupee amount saved and a select options button.

process.title: Sale campaigns
process.body: The current sale has its own menu item and a full-width homepage banner, and a free delivery threshold runs in the announcement bar across every page.

process.title: Mobile shopping
process.body: On phones, a fixed bottom bar with home, shop, wishlist and cart stays in reach while browsing, and shoe sizes are shown with both EU and UK numbers.

whyItMatters: A brand that sells to the whole family needs each shopper to find their own section quickly. Picture links, visible savings and a simple mobile bar make a wide range feel easy to browse.

faqs.q: What platform is the Starlet store built on?
faqs.a: It runs on Shopify with the Glozin theme, using Shopify collections for men's, women's and kids' footwear, fragrances and sale edits.

faqs.q: Can Pixel2Tech build a similar Shopify store for my brand?
faqs.a: Yes. We design and build Shopify stores for footwear and fashion brands, including department menus, picture-led collections and sale campaigns. Tell us about your catalog and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
